title: Obsidian Attachmenter
subtitle: Obsidian Attachment Management Plugin
description: A plugin for Obsidian to manage attachments with per-note folder rules, remote image downloading, and path checking tools.
longDescription: A comprehensive Obsidian plugin designed to streamline attachment management. It enforces a per-note attachment folder structure, keeping your vault organized. Key capabilities include automatically moving pasted images to the correct folder, downloading remote images (including from Canvas) to local storage, and providing tools to check and repair broken attachment paths or clean up empty folders. It supports multiple languages and integrates seamlessly with Obsidian's file explorer.
challenges: Integrating with Obsidian's internal link management
Supporting both Markdown and Canvas files
solutions: Used Obsidian's vault events to track changes
Developed custom handlers for Canvas nodes
